findings.quote: The HCl extract was neutralized with 2M NaOH
findings.message: The subsequent processing explicitly retains the HCl extract, so the preceding HCl extraction should retain the aqueous phase rather than an unknown phase.

findings.quote: extracted with EtOAc and the EtOAc phase was dried (K2CO3) and evaporated
findings.message: The source explicitly retains the EtOAc phase for drying and evaporation. This separation should retain the organic phase rather than an unknown phase.
